query:
WITH
    statistics AS (
        SELECT
            AVG(cnt) AS mean_cnt,
            STDDEV (cnt) AS sd_cnt
        FROM
            (
                SELECT
                    wealth_level,
                    COUNT(*) AS cnt
                FROM
                    estishraf_llm_wealth_index
                GROUP BY
                    wealth_level
            ) lc
    ),
    lvl AS (
        SELECT
            wealth_level,
            COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM
            estishraf_llm_wealth_index
                GROUP BY
            wealth_level
    )
SELECT
    l.wealth_level,
    l.cnt,
    ROUND(s.mean_cnt, 2) AS mean_cnt,
    ROUND(s.sd_cnt, 2) AS sd_cnt,
    ROUND((l.cnt - s.mean_cnt) / s.sd_cnt, 2) AS z_score
FROM
    lvl l
        CROSS JOIN statistics s
ORDER BY
    ABS(ROUND((l.cnt - s.mean_cnt) / s.sd_cnt, 2)) DESC
    LIMIT 1
